about.label: About
about.headline: From Biology to Code, From Lab to Product
about.p1: Biomedical Engineering at UNC Córdoba: thesis submitted, defense pending. The thesis is TraumaVision, an academic prototype that detects fractures on pediatric wrist X-rays. I built the model, the API and the web app.
about.p2: Since August 2026 I work full-time in Córdoba as Automation Specialist at LEEX, a medical equipment company, and as AI Engineer at KIBBO, a maintenance platform for hospital equipment. In 2026 I also founded Eleven, a web and AI agency that runs on an agent pipeline I built on the Claude API.
about.p3: First place at Rocking the Industry (RTS Group, 2025), an industrial hackathon with 150 multidisciplinary teams, with team Algarroba LID.
about.p4: Based in Córdoba, Argentina. English: B2 (LTC Eastbourne, UK) and full-time work in California in an English-only workplace.

videos.note: AI post-production: Claude Code agents edit, animate and render each piece in Remotion; music and SFX for B6 and KIBBO were finished in CapCut. The three product reels start from iPhone footage; the MRI explainer and the model comparison are 100% AI-made.

b6_story.title: Where the incubator came from
b6_story.caption: In 1878, a Paris obstetrician had a zoo's poultry incubator adapted for newborns; with controlled heat alone, premature mortality fell from 66% to 38%. LEEX's B6 incubator builds on the same idea.
b6_story.made_with: Made with: Claude Code · Remotion · React Three Fiber · faster-whisper · FFmpeg · CapCut. iPhone footage, Wellcome Collection engravings
b6_story.credit: Engravings: Wellcome Collection, via Wikimedia Commons · <license>CC BY 4.0</license> · cropped, color-treated, camera-animated.

kibbo_film.title: Preventive maintenance, from plan to execution
kibbo_film.caption: A maintenance plan takes a week to build, and the first unplanned failure puts schedule and staff out of sync. The reel shows KIBBO's preventive task list: one filterable list, visible to the whole team.
kibbo_film.made_with: Made with: Claude Code · Remotion · faster-whisper · Python audio · FFmpeg · CapCut. iPhone footage, UI rebuilt in code

v8v_cpr.title: One-button CPR position
v8v_cpr.caption: LEEX's V8v electric hospital bed has a CPR function on a single button: pressing it lays the bed fully flat for resuscitation.
v8v_cpr.made_with: Made with: Claude Code · Remotion · faster-whisper · Python-synthesized SFX · FFmpeg. iPhone footage, Mixkit music

mri_explainer.title: How an MRI works
mri_explainer.caption: MRI uses no camera and no X-rays. Hydrogen nuclei in the body's water align in a strong magnetic field; a radio pulse at their resonance frequency excites them, and gradient coils encode position so the returning signal can be reconstructed as an image. Script researched from 20 institutional sources.
mri_explainer.made_with: Made with: Claude Code · Remotion · React Three Fiber · edge-tts · faster-whisper · NumPy-synthesized score. 100% AI, no stock footage

model_comparison.title: Same prompt, three models
model_comparison.caption: The same prompt sent to three AI models: a WebGPU soft-body simulation of a gummy citrus slice that can be stretched and twisted. Side-by-side screen recordings show each result with the working time and tokens each model reported. 104,531 impressions on LinkedIn.
model_comparison.made_with: Made with: WebGPU builds from three AI models · OBS · Remotion · Claude Code

Founded and run a web and AI agency for SMBs. Built its agent pipeline on the Claude API, covering discovery, strategy, brand, development and QA.

Corrective and preventive maintenance of medical equipment in adult and pediatric ICU, OR and wards, under Joint Commission International (JCI) standards. Equipment: defibrillators (Philips/Feas), multiparameter monitors, infusion pumps (Braun), surgical tables (Steris), incubators (Medix/Atom), Datascope IABP, endoscopes, fetal monitors, ECG/SpO2/capnography. Calibrations with Fluke. Inventory traceability in Neovero CMMS.
